messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: Solstice wants to extend their current commitment by adding seats mid-term but they only have one PO that covers the US parent. They want an amendment that (1) adds 18 seats, (2) bills the incremental seats to Canada entity (Solstice Canada Inc.), and (3) provides a 6-month free trial for enablement services. They also asked for VAT-exempt invoice if possible. Can we support?
owen_sales: VAT exempt for Canada isn't applicable; Canada has GST/HST. We need their Canadian Business Number. Also free trial for enablement services 00should be disbursed as credit line in amendment.
ira_fin: Finance: separate invoice to Canada is possible but we need Canadian BN + remit address. If they expect VAT-exempt, we need proof of export or specific tax forms; unlikely. Payment terms default net30.
jen_legal: Free trial credit needs scope and termination conditions  I will draft a short SOW attachment for the enablement 6-month trial. Also need signatory confirmation for Canada entity.
maria_cs: They confirmed BN = 123456789 RT, want trial to start on 2024-05-01. Seats = 18, seat rate = $1,100/seat/yr. Term end aligns with parent contract 2025-06-30. Can Billing compute prorated amount?
owen_sales: Ok will approve seat add. Note: they request that training credit cannot be transferred or refunded; include that clause.
ira_fin: Calculation formula: prorated_amount = seats * seat_rate * (remaining_days / total_term_days). For these numbers: remaining days ~ 425? need exact. If trial credit applies only to enablement invoice, separate bookkeeping required.
docu_sign_bot: DocuSign envelope prepared: solstice-canada-amd-2024. Set to standard e-sign.
maria_cs: Customer also asked for consolidated PO mapping sheet to attach to their procurement system showing old PO -> new amendment link. Can we provide one?
jen_legal: Yes. Also include signature attestation for Canada signatory and clause: "training credit is non-refundable and void if SOW not executed within 30 days."
owen_sales: I'll send final seat and price calc to Finance. Maria, can you request the Canadian BN documentation and remit address?
maria_cs: On it. I'll ask them to provide GST/HST number and signatory contact. Target: draft amendment by 2024-03-12, signoff by 2024-03-18, billing processed after.
ira_fin: Fine but note: cross-border billing may introduce FX handling; will invoice in USD to Canadian entity unless they request CAD. If CAD invoice, use daily FX at invoice date.
maria_cs: Thanks. I'll keep thread posted. :email:
